orderKey.between: the shortest length at which a key strictly between the neighbours exists; at that length, the middle of the keys of that length strictly between them, rounded down, the keys read as base-37 numbers over the alphabet; a middle ending in '-' moves one key down (to one ending in 'z'), or one up when it is the first such key
orderKey.respace: when no key fits, re-key the fewest neighbours around the insertion point in the same change set, the window balanced and its left side first, and never the whole collection

names.name: okf:about
names.meaning: What a document or a collection is about; made by people and later by a domain's steward, never by the import.

names.name: okf:related_to
names.meaning: Two concepts that belong together; made by people and later by a domain's steward.

names.name: okf:links_to
names.meaning: A document's link to another node; a predicated link keeps its predicate's text in okf:predicate.

names.name: okf:type
names.meaning: On a Concept, its kind of thing in the grammar (person, project, topic, ...); on a Resource, the frontmatter's type as written.

names.name: okf:importance
names.meaning: An optional integer 0-100 that ranks search results and what an agent loads first; never decides order; never written by the import.

names.name: okf:directory
names.meaning: On a Collection, the id of the dir entry of its domain it is bound to, mirrored in kg_file_refs.

names.name: okf:integrity
names.meaning: The file's trust family as the drive states it; untrusted for anything under the drive's untrusted globs.

names.name: okf:status
names.meaning: The frontmatter's status (draft, stable, deprecated) as written.

names.name: okf:generated_at
names.meaning: The frontmatter's generated.at text when it does not parse as a time.

names.name: okf:generated_by
names.meaning: The frontmatter's generated.by as written; the event's actor stays the importing tool.

names.name: okf:verified
names.meaning: The frontmatter's verified record as text; only a person's verify_assertion verifies a node.

names.name: okf:extra
names.meaning: One map of every frontmatter key the profile does not name, each key as written to its value.

names.name: okf:bundle
names.meaning: On a Collection, the OKF bundle's name as the drive's config declares it.

names.name: okf:entry
names.meaning: On a bundle's Collection, the bundle's entry document as the config names it.

names.name: okf:index
names.meaning: On a bundle's Collection, the parsed boolean index setting, including false. It does not name a file or assert that one exists.

names.name: okf:log
names.meaning: On a bundle's Collection, the parsed boolean log setting, including false. It does not name a file or assert that one exists.

names.name: okf:listed
names.meaning: On a staging zone's Collection, the config's listing note: a snapshot, not an inventory.

names.name: okf:drive_okf_version
names.meaning: On a drive's Collection, the drive's own OKF version, never read as the profile's.

names.name: okf:no_index
names.meaning: On a drive's Collection, the drive config's no_index list as written.

names.name: okf:profile_version
names.meaning: On the domain's one root Collection, the profile version applied; written only by the profile tool.

names.name: okf:profile_nodes
names.meaning: On the domain's root Collection, each profile name's Vocabulary node id; written only by the profile tool.

names.name: okf:summary
names.meaning: Reserved: a text of the node's own, longer than a description, as a typed reference to a content the node owns. Nothing writes it in this program.

names.name: okf:plan
names.meaning: Reserved provenance: the plan a generated text was written under. Nothing writes it in this program.

names.name: okf:model
names.meaning: Reserved provenance: the model that wrote a generated text. Nothing writes it in this program.

names.name: okf:prompt
names.meaning: Reserved provenance: the prompt a generated text was written from. Nothing writes it in this program.

names.name: okf:generator
names.meaning: Reserved provenance: the job or tool that wrote a generated text. Nothing writes it in this program.

names.name: okf:source_content_id
names.meaning: Reserved provenance: the source a generated text was written from; for a file, its (entry_id, revision). Nothing writes it in this program.

names.name: okf:predicate
names.meaning: On okf:links_to, a predicated link's predicate text as written.

names.name: okf:source_id
names.meaning: On a sources edge, the frontmatter source entry's id as written.

names.name: okf:source_title
names.meaning: On a sources edge, the frontmatter source entry's title as written.

names.name: okf:source_author
names.meaning: On a sources edge, the frontmatter source entry's author as written.

modelText.note: A node's note is a content the node owns that neither a reserved property nor its description_source_id references; the profile reserves no property for it.
rules: A generated text is marked generated and is unverified until a person verifies it.
It is tied to the exact node revision or manifest content id it was made from, and is stale when that moves.
One domain's text goes only to that domain's configured provider, a local one for a local_only drive.
Nothing is taken from outside content (the drive's untrusted globs) or from a labelled file.
The not-instructions sentence comes before the content, and no tool is offered.
